items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I was listening first to Jimmy Smith and some kind of r & b-ish jazz.

ctx.x: Beach Boys stuff and all that?

Yeah. Beach Boys and Dick Dale and the Daletones. Some really awful music for the most part. But I was having a lot of fun and making some money on the weekends playing dances. And then this band leader of a very good rhythm & blues band in San Diego, George Semper was his name, somehow he asked me join his band, which was miles above my abilities. And I loved it. And they seemed to think I was going to do okay, and I started, because it was very syncopated and I’d been playing this very straight up and down kind…
Yeah, there was very few guys.
